Tottenham Defeat Crystal Palace Following Early Red Card for Mateta

02 Nov 2026, 04:30 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Sports Desk · Source: www.theguardian.com

Key takeaways Match Overview Tottenham secured a victory against Crystal Palace, extending their winning run and moving into the top half of the table. The match hinged significantly on an early red card that reduced the visitors to 10 players. * **Final Outcome:** Tottenham claime

Match Overview

Tottenham secured a victory against Crystal Palace, extending their winning run and moving into the top half of the table. The match hinged significantly on an early red card that reduced the visitors to 10 players.

  • Final Outcome: Tottenham claimed the win following goals from Archie Gray and Jan Paul van Hecke.
  • Key Turning Point: Jean-Philippe Mateta was sent off in the 13th minute after a VAR review upgraded his initial yellow card for a challenge on Micky van de Ven.
  • Team Momentum: The result marks Tottenham's third successive victory, a milestone they had not reached in over 600 days.

Crystal Palace Struggles and Managerial Uncertainty

For Crystal Palace, the defeat marks their third consecutive league loss, leaving them in the relegation zone and placing manager Pierre Sage's future under intense scrutiny.

  • Managerial Pressure: Reports indicate Sage's position is uncertain following the slide into the bottom three, with upcoming fixtures against Liverpool before the international break.
  • Disciplinary Issues: Mateta's dismissal compounded earlier disciplinary troubles for Palace this season, following Axel Disasi's red card against Ipswich.
  • Sage's Response: Speaking after the match, Sage expressed a defiant attitude, stating he remains focused on preparing the team and taking responsibility for the situation.
